given: The home stock-by-location table is showing one or more stock rows
when: The team member views the quantity column
then: The quantity values are right-aligned within their column
architectural_notes: Presentation-only column alignment on the rendered table. Covered by the client Vitest/Playwright harness asserting the quantity column alignment, rather than the branch integration suite, since no server or persistence behavior is exercised.

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts that filed records appear as rows with their SKU/location/quantity values; AC2 asserts only the presentation (right-alignment) of the quantity column. A build could list every row with correct values yet render quantities left-aligned, failing AC2 while AC1 stays green, and vice versa.
